dct_description_sm: This dataset displays the name, website and locations of Ontario Farmers Markets, as derived from the Farmers Markets of Ontario Website. The 2 datasets available below are zipped files containing: * .kmz files for use with Google Earth or similar Keyhole Markup Language (KML) compatible software * shapefiles for use with GIS software For instructions on how to use Google Earth, read the [Google Earth tutorial](http://www.google.com/earth/index.html).
